title: Major meh.
text: I'm pretty sure the April 2019 box has caused a lot of cancelled subscriptions. Super duper boring. Three hair products (two of them anti-frizz things), an uninteresting eye shadow, an eye liner, an eye shadow brush... third one in three boxes... seriously? I guess there are people who hoard make up brushes, but I am not one of them. Oh and a fake tan towelette... let me repeat that: a fake.tan.towelette. :/
label: negative
